decision.rationale: The accountable human reviewed structured proposal prp-457de1ae00ba4ee4afc07b2fac5b0de1 and admitted that exact task through an explicit admission control, then separately authorized one baseline commit only in the no-remote disposable consumer. On 2026-08-17 the retained validated wheel installed offline into a fresh Python 3.11 environment, the synthetic consumer returned READY_TO_RESERVE with six passing checks, and one visible terminal apply received exact human RESERVE confirmation and exited successfully. Exactly one valid reserved marker was created, and one in-memory reserved correlation bridge bound to its exact identity and digest passed with no Harness run. No retry, replay, consume transition, real consumer, network call, existing-installation change, starter Git operation, cleanup, publication, release, or deployment occurred. All 884 supported-Python tests passed with 2 platform-limited skips, governance had no deterministic failure, and a distinct bounded current-Agent advisory review corrected one current-status wording contradiction before finding no remaining correction-required requirement, authority, privacy, implementation, or scope drift. The task is paused so the reservation cannot be retried, reused, consumed, or treated as follow-on authority.

requirement.summary: Use the retained wheel with SHA256 78D6A216FE7344A2E3DA01086A7A92B9F3310BE61DAD2E690B0705003221FDE6 to create one fresh disposable Python 3.11 installation and one fresh no-remote disposable Git consumer, prepare one synthetic READY replay-preflight plan with strict local Adapter metadata and an unused rpf correlation identifier, then invoke the installed reservation apply exactly once in a visible interactive terminal. The human must type exact RESERVE. Cancellation, terminal closure, nonzero exit, BLOCKED, UNKNOWN, or uncertain outcome stops without retry. On success, verify the exclusive marker against the plan and validate one in-memory reserved correlation bridge using the development-source validator. Do not launch or consume a replay, modify the existing global installation, use network access, clean retained temporary evidence, commit or push the starter repository, publish, release, or deploy.

items: The visible terminal requires a real human confirmation; automated input would invalidate the rehearsal claim.
A retry after an uncertain terminal outcome could create duplicate or ambiguous reservation evidence, so only one apply invocation is permitted.
The disposable consumer must remain isolated, contain no remote, and use only synthetic data.
Reservation and reserved-bridge validation must not be represented as replay authorization, consumption, Harness evidence, or product effectiveness.
Temporary absolute paths and raw terminal transcripts must not enter repository evidence.
The working tree already contains prior admitted-task changes and user-owned .codex content that must remain untouched.
